title: Beyond the 956: Barbara Barrie, Oscar-nominated 'Breaking Away' and 'Barney Miller' actress, dies at 95
excerpt: Barbara Barrie, the Oscar-nominated actress known for 'Breaking Away,' 'Barney Miller,' and the original Broadway cast of 'Company,' has died at 95. Her daughter Jane Harnick confirmed to The New York Times that Barrie died Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at her home in New York City.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Barbara Barrie, the Oscar-nominated actress known for Breaking Away, Barney Miller, and the original Broadway cast of Company, has died at 95.

Barrie died on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at her home in New York City, her daughter Jane Harnick confirmed to The New York Times. According to her daughter, Barrie's death was medically assisted following a terminal cancer diagnosis.

Born Barbara Ann Berman in Chicago in 1931, Barrie built a career that spanned more than six decades across stage, film, and television. Her film breakthrough came in One Potato, Two Potato (1964), for which she won the Best Actress award at the Cannes Film Festival.

On Broadway, she originated the role of Sarah in Stephen Sondheim's Company in 1970, earning a Tony nomination for her performance. She returned to Broadway many times over the years, including in California Suite, Torch Song Trilogy, and, in 2017, Significant Other.

Film audiences remember her best as Evelyn in Breaking Away (1979), a performance that brought her an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actress. On television, she played Elizabeth Miller, the wife of the title character, on the sitcom Barney Miller from 1975 to 1978, and later appeared on Suddenly Susan, Law & Order, Nurse Jackie, and Enlightened. She also voiced Alcmene in Disney's animated Hercules (1997).

Beyond acting, Barrie was an author of novels and children's books. She is survived by her two children and three grandchildren.

Sources: The New York Times (via daughter Jane Harnick); Playbill; BroadwayWorld; Just Jared.
